_comment: Sample. `harness-init --hooks` merges this into .claude/settings.json (or merge by hand). Exec form (command + args) avoids shell quoting of paths; $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is expanded in args. SessionStart prints handoff + active todos + check counts and records the errors that already exist. PreToolUse blocks code edits while an active L todo has an unapproved planning (Bash edits are not covered). UserPromptSubmit adds a one-line reminder to record new ideas as a backlog todo instead of building them. Stop blocks finishing on errors that are new since session start (exit 2; second try allowed via stop_hook_active). To make a crashing gate block instead of warn, add "onFailure": "block" to the PreToolUse hook (Claude Code 2.1.295+). permissions.deny keeps secrets unreadable in every mode.
